spec_match.rationale: Targets the change's precise wording — 'created earlier in the same iteration' — by measuring task-created vs rAF-created transitions separately, the two creation contexts the old behavior treated differently.

interactive.rationale: One button runs 3 real trials per context; the comparison table fills with measured medians and both squares visibly transition.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the side-by-side per-context latencies; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Timeouts render as no-event; the same trial-reset race as the sibling lab was fixed (400ms settle); the verdict copy was corrected after live data showed the per-context split opposite to the initial guess — the page now describes whatever it measures without asserting which context defers.

conformance.rationale: The suite's two same-iteration assertions (task-created and rAF-created) are exactly this table's two rows.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP runs: measured a genuine per-context split — task-created 1 tick (15.8ms), rAF-created 0 ticks — re-verified from a fresh reload after the copy correction; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: 0-tick cells emerald, deferral cells amber on near-white rows (AA); table scrolls in its wrapper; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with scoped headers; squares aria-hidden; status aria-live restates the verdict.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table scrolls inside .tbl-wrap; 0px page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Confirm 0/0 on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: The spec-aligned engine should read 0 ticks for both creation contexts, collapsing the measured split.

guidanceConsulted.query: comparison table live counts screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Comparisons in real table semantics with worded verdicts.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scoped-header table plus an aria-live status wording the measured split.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let prior side effects settle between trials.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 400ms settle after each reset so each trial creates a fresh transition.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the lab measured a real per-context split on Chromium 141 (task-created defers 1 tick, rAF-created doesn't) — data that corrected the page's own initial assumption, now worded measurement-neutrally. Fresh-reload evidence, clean console, both viewports.
